ValidationRule.description: Mandating to fill out a reason when a CMOS complaint meet or does not meet RG 271 delay criteria
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c), NOT(ISNEW()), OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Non_Customer_Complaint', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Complaint' ), OR( ISCHANGED(Has_complaint_met_RG_271_delay_criteria__c), ISCHANGED(How_has_delay_criteria_been_met_not_met__c) ), OR( AND( NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Has_complaint_met_RG_271_delay_criteria__c))), OR( ISBLANK(How_has_delay_criteria_been_met_not_met__c), PRIORVALUE(How_has_delay_criteria_been_met_not_met__c) = How_has_delay_criteria_been_met_not_met__c ) ), AND( ISCHANGED(Has_complaint_met_RG_271_delay_criteria__c), NOT(ISCHANGED(How_has_delay_criteria_been_met_not_met__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Has_complaint_met_RG_271_delay_criteria__c))), ISBLANK(How_has_delay_criteria_been_met_not_met__c) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please update, How the delay criteria been met/not met.
